Debug.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: YC Island uses Automation to control Apple Music, supported terminals, and recording controls when you use those features.
Debug.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: YC Island uses Apple Music to fetch animated artwork for the lock screen wallpaper.
Debug.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: YC Island needs audio capture permission to show the real-time music waveform and to set the volume of individual apps. Audio is only processed live and is never recorded or saved.
Debug.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: YC Island uses Bluetooth to show connected audio devices and their battery levels.
Debug.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: YC Island reads your calendar to show upcoming events in the island and on the lock screen.
Debug.NSCameraUsageDescription: YC Island uses your camera only when you open the live mirror. No video is recorded or saved.
Debug.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: YC Island accesses Desktop files you add to Shelf.
Debug.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: YC Island accesses Documents files you add to Shelf.
Debug.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: YC Island reads Downloads to show download progress and access files you add to Shelf.
Debug.NSLocationUsageDescription: YC Island uses your location for local weather when you allow it.
Debug.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: YC Island uses your location for local weather when you allow it.
Debug.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: YC Island shows your reminders and marks them complete when you choose.
